title: Choosing a film at home

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: 今晩、映画を見ませんか。怖い映画を持っています。
turns.translation: Shall we watch a film tonight? I have a scary film.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 怖い映画は苦手です。面白い映画がいいです。
turns.translation: I'm not good with scary films. I'd prefer an entertaining one.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: じゃ、面白いのを借りてきます。先に映画を見ますか。
turns.translation: Then I'll borrow an entertaining one. Shall we watch the film first?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 先に晩ご飯を食べましょう。その後で、ゆっくり見たいです。
turns.translation: Let's eat dinner first. I'd like to watch it at leisure afterwards.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: 分かりました。飲み物も買っていきます。何人来ますか。
turns.translation: All right. I'll buy drinks and bring them too. How many people are coming?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 私と妹とあなたで三人です。三人分お願いします。
turns.translation: There will be three of us: my younger sister, you, and me. Enough for three, please.
